title: SEC/CvRDT property test (concurrent writers converge)
description: Prove the coordination-free guarantee: concurrent writers folding disjoint/overlapping piles converge to a BIT-IDENTICAL root; two-root merge = fold of the union; non-serialized writes lose no data (roots never clobber piles).

title: Incremental fold on upload + two-root merge O(diff)
description: Event-driven incremental fold: a new pile folds in O(pile + log N) via path-copy, O(log N) memory. Two roots merge to root(A union B) in O(diff) via the RBSR descent (tree-join). No re-fold from scratch.

title: Store trait: S3 + R2 drivers (strong RAW + conditional writes)
description: One store trait over S3 and R2: strong read-after-write + single-key CAS (S3 If-Match / R2 onlyIf), presigned or GET serving, LIST for the pile set. Never use an eventually-consistent KV for root. Foundational for the CF runtime.

title: Land FaaS concurrency + Cloudflare Workers deployment (coordination-free)
description: Land the coordination-free FaaS / CF Workers design goals from DESIGN.md sec Concurrency & FaaS and WORKSPACES.md sec 9: content-addressed CRDT with Strong Eventual Consistency, non-serialized (no lease by default), fat B-tree MST/prolly nodes (no manifest), one-sided RBSR against a dumb store, generational GC, Workers-exclusive deployment.

title: Fat B-tree Merkle nodes (drop the flat manifest)
description: DESIGN.md sec Concurrency & FaaS. Move the layout from a binary treap + flat manifest to fat B-tree (MST/prolly) nodes: each node carries every child (hash, fingerprint). Self-describing + shallow (~2-3 levels) so no separate manifest object. Foundational for the rest.

title: Precomputed fingerprints + reader-driven pruned walk (GET-only)
description: Bake fingerprints into the immutable nodes so a DUMB store answers a reader-driven fingerprint-pruned walk with only GETs (git dumb-HTTP over a Merkle DAG). Range-read the node fingerprint region to trim bytes.

title: Non-serialized root: append-only roots set + amortized merge (drop the lease)
description: Publish roots into an append-only roots/ set; truth = merge(live roots), never clobbered. Amortize merge/sweep into every fold + authoritative read (deterministic merges dedup by hash, no storm). CAS-pointer (S3 If-Match / R2 onlyIf) and blind-LWW+sweep as variants. Remove the single-writer lease as the default; lease/DO becomes a per-workspace opt-in.

title: Update MULTILEVEL_PILE.md A.5 with the deep-chain result
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 3.8 / 8. Replace the star caveat with deep-chain numbers for all shapes (star/wide/random/chain) plus depth histograms. State honestly which shapes it helps and by how much (path-length vs N).
close_reason: Replaced the star caveat with 49,999-fact star/wide/random/chain histograms and tax tables, plus shallow/deep and multi-device verdicts.

title: Hand-back: acceptance checklist + verdict
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 8 / 9. Confirm the acceptance criteria and deliver the one-paragraph verdict: does aligning key order to the real delegation tree turn the range-sync tax from O(members) into O(depth), and does it matter for the realistic shallow-wide shape or only the adversarial deep one?

title: add_member(inviter=...): build real invite chains
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 4.2. Generalize tests/util.add_member to take an explicit inviter identity (default founder); resolve the inviter member offer (was admin). Invariant: ts(inviter.join) < ts(invite) < ts(join), monotone along a chain so the closure DAG stays acyclic.
close_reason: add_member accepts explicit member identities, resolves their member offer, enforces strict chain timestamps, and is covered by a real closed-pile chain test.

title: seed_chain.py: grow a delegation forest (tunable shape)
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 4.3. Bulk-insert like bench_sync (O(n log n), never replay turns). Shapes star/wide/random/chain; record the realized depth histogram (min/median/max hops to root). Author messages as today. Realism: real graphs are shallow-and-wide, so measure all shapes and do not report only the deep number.
close_reason: Added bulk-built star/wide/random/chain seeds with strict delegation timestamps, depth histograms, deterministic topology, content, and realistic closure tests.

title: bench_order on chained seed: measure tax by depth
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 4.4. Verify the deleg reconstruction recovers the multi-hop tree via JOINS, not the ephemeral invitee field (sec 7 trap). Measure ts/author/deleg. Hypothesis: deleg tax ~ 4 x depth(subtree), path-length-bounded not N-bounded; deleg beats author/ts on the deep shape and reproduces A.5 on the star. Add a depth column.
close_reason: bench_order now measures all four chained shapes, reconstructs delegation through user refs, reports depth-aware semantic subtree tax, and proves DFS path scaling with regression tests and a full 49,999-fact run.

title: Green guard: bench_sync + check_leaves on chained seed
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 7.3. bench_sync catchup/bidi and check_leaves (leaves-are-piles) must still pass on the chained seed: every published leaf carries its full delegation closure. Use it as an oracle.
close_reason: All four chained shapes pass check_leaves, fresh catchup, and bidirectional reconciliation; realistic guard tests added and full suite passes.

title: Port poc-13 auth into poc-16 + test hoisting on chained seeds
description: See CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md (plan) and WORKSPACES.md (settled model). Unlock deep delegation via member-can-invite, build chained seeds, measure the hoisting key-order tax by depth, and close the depth-1 star caveat in MULTILEVEL_PILE.md A.5. Uses poc-13 naming.

title: Rename auth families to poc-13 names (mechanical, keep green)
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 2 / 3.0. genesis to workspace, invite to user_invite, join to user, tag sig to signature. Touches every import plus tests/benches (tests/util.py, bench_sync.py, bench_order.py, cli.py, cmds.py, content/message.py). One green commit before any semantic change. Keep the poc-16 baked-in workspace bootstrap (founder = member+admin); the poc-13 split founder-user + bootstrap-admin flow is an optional follow-up.
close_reason: Renamed auth families and tags to poc-13 vocabulary; full test suite passes.

title: member-can-invite: user_invite.needs admin to member
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 1 / 4.1. Change the one needs() line admin to member; docstring states any member or the founder may invite. Unit test: a member-signed invite validates, a non-member-signed one is rejected. This one line is the whole depth mechanism, and per WORKSPACES.md the same primitive powers cross-device mirroring and infra.
close_reason: Member-gated user invites implemented in validation and command closure, with positive member and negative outsider tests.

title: Cloudflare Workers runtime + sizing conformance
description: Run the engine on CF Workers exclusively: R2 store, fold triggered by R2 event notifications to Queues, cold rebuild via a Durable Object alarm loop or copy-the-tree. Conformance: O(log N) mem / O(ms) incremental CPU within 128MB/30s (5min), pile parses in a few MB, Workers-exclusive (no heavy tier).

title: Generational GC (Merkle reachability over a grace window)
description: Reclaim only objects no root within a grace window reaches (git-gc + reflog window). The folder that path-copies stamps superseded nodes with a grace expiry; reclamation lazy, never on the correctness path.

title: Reader modes: fast vs authoritative; RYW/monotonic/causal
description: One read primitive (walk store, pruned by fingerprint, scoped by range). Fast = walk a recent root (may lag). Authoritative = reconcile (root-vs-LIST diff or peer fingerprint diff); empty-prior = full catch-up. RYW client-side (fold own pile after PUT); monotonic reads via a watermark (merge, never replace); causal free from dep-closure.

title: keychain.py: plural identities above workspaces
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 5. Generalize keyring.json (one sk) to plural keys = a flat device set (all equal, no ruler; recovery by readmission, WORKSPACES.md). Not a fact, never syncs; mirror local_signer_secret simplicity. Structure only, no new measurement.
close_reason: Added migrating plural node-local keychain, per-workspace bindings used by commands/sync, seed identity retention, and persistence/behavior tests.

title: admin.py: delegable evict authority (optional)
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 3.7. Port the poc-13 admin grant (member-gated by the founder root) if evict authority should delegate beyond the founder. Independent of the measurement; skip if not needed.
close_reason: Added recursively delegable admin facts gated by signer admin and target membership; runtime test promotes two hops and executes eviction.

title: device/device_invite + direct-key grant form
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 6. user-vs-device split. WORKSPACES.md: the device-targeted invite is a one-step direct-key grant (names a known key, no ephemeral key and no separate join), which can collapse device_invite+device to a single grant for the known-key case. Gate behind seed flag devices_per_user (default 1 = Phase 1 behavior).
close_reason: Added self-bound device and one-step direct-key device grant families, equal-peer authority, materialized roster, multi-device seeds, and kernel/runtime/closure tests.

title: user-order measurement (user vs device grouping)
description: CHAINED_AUTH_PLAN.md sec 6. Add a user order to bench_order: group a device set keys together, then DFS over device sets. Show user-grouping >= device-grouping when devices_per_user > 1. The one place the device layer changes a number rather than only the shape.
close_reason: Added roster-aware user DFS order and devices=N benchmark flag; multi-device regression proves lower rho, mean tax, and per-target tax than device-author grouping.
